title: vriesea cowellii
intro: Vriesea cowellii, commonly known as the "Lion's Tail," is a species of flowering plant in the bromeliad family. This epiphytic plant is known for its vibrant, red and yellow flowers and is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The Vriesea cowellii plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of Vriesea cowellii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
